about.title: About Advent Of Code
about.text: Advent of Code (AoC) is an annual global event in the form of an advent calendar for programmers. Instead of chocolate, you get 12 programming puzzles that you can solve in any language you like. It is all about the joy of problem solving - everyone is warmly invited to give the puzzles a try. You can find out more on the <link>official Advent of Code website</link>.
join.title: Join in and grab some merch
join.text: Neuland provides you with a club-internal leaderboard where you can compete against other members. Whoever ends up in 1st place wins and gets to pick a T-shirt from our merch shop.
join.step1Title: 1. Sign in to Advent Of Code
join.step1Text: Sign in on the <link>official AoC website</link>.
join.step2Text: On the AoC website, go to the leaderboard page and enter the invite code below. Done! It takes a few minutes until your entry is picked up. After that you are in and will be shown on the Neuland Leaderboard.

end.congrats: Congratulations! The winner gets to pick a T-shirt from our merch shop as the prize. Please check your messages when the organizing team contacts you.
end.tieText: In the event of a tie, the club decides who wins. Find out more in the <link>terms of participation</link>.
end.noWinner: No points were awarded, so there is no winner.
